name: editStatutoryItems
description: Updates an existing Statutory Item record by modifying its name.

basic.name: editStatutoryItems
basic.description: Updates an existing Statutory Item record by modifying its name.

args.name: statutoryCode
args.description: The statutory item code to identify the record to edit (e.g., "000005"). Either statutoryCode or statutoryName must be provided.

args.name: statutoryName
args.description: The statutory item name to identify the record to edit (e.g., "Pension Scheme"). Either statutoryCode or statutoryName must be provided.

args.name: newStatutoryName
args.description: The new name for the statutory item.
